title: T640 Hardware
description: Author: Oliver Ristow. SNMP hardware history and optional existing Redfish PCIe health. Built for the measurements verified on this T640.

panels.title: System health
panels.description: Latest sample within five minutes, independent of the selected historical range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac" and r._field == "system_status" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}")
  |> last()

panels.title: Telemetry age
panels.description: Age of the most recent overall SNMP health sample, refreshed every minute. Missing samples older than five minutes show NO RECENT DATA.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac" and r._field == "system_status" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, _field: "Sample age"}))

panels.title: System and storage health
panels.description: Raw status codes with explicit value mappings. Gaps over 150 seconds are disconnected; missing data is not mapped to OK.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac" and r._field == "system_status" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "System"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "monitoring")

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac_power" and r._field == "reading_raw" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}" and r.sensor == "System Board Pwr Consumption")

panels.title: PSU input current
panels.description: Observed type-23 current probes report tenths of amps: divide by 10. Low-resolution current samples should not be used to calculate precise power.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac_power" and r._field == "reading_raw" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}" and (r.sensor == "PS1 Current 1" or r.sensor == "PS2 Current 2"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 10.0}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.sensor}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: PCIe cards: reported health
panels.description: Uses the existing HTTP PCIe collection if it was retained. Only configured devices are polled; automatic PCIe discovery is not implemented. No SMART wear, temperature or media errors are inferred.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac_pcie" and r._field == "health" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.device_name + " [" + r.device + "]"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac_memory" and r._field == "status" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.dimm})) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "idrac_cpu" and r._field == "status" and r.source == "${idrac:raw}") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: if r.index == "1.1" then "CPU1" else if r.index == "1.2" then "CPU2" else "CPU " + r.index})) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

options.content:
**Status is history; charts show readings.** Each PSU, disk, array, controller and sensor gets its own lane. All rows come from collected tags.

**Different enums:** disk state 3 = online, RAID state 2 = online, hardware health 3 = OK. A red enclosure rollup can reflect a failed disk while the backplane itself remains ready.

**Freshness:** top cards use a five-minute lookback; telemetry age turns amber after 150 seconds. Charts disconnect gaps above 150 seconds. Missing data is not proof of health. Long time ranges are downsampled; brief status events can be hidden.

**Scope:** iDRAC hardware health; no OS CPU/RAM utilization, predictive failure, NVMe SMART or energy meter is implied. PCIe health appears only if the existing HTTP input is enabled.
